correctness.rationale: The three-step cap-affine contraction has a unique periodic state. The mass balance W=U−(1−q)Σx_i and anchored-saturation lemma reduce the two cycles to exact finite min/max formulas. For abc last event anchors every spilling orbit; for acb either second or third does. Set A=f_a(C), B=f_b(A), D=f_c(A), E=f_b(C), F=f_a(E). Since D≥B and E+F≥A+B, runoff is ordered. Both strict differences require a<b<c, B<C and positive abc spill, equivalent to the sharp open capacity bounds. Independently checked rational closed-form fixed points on 6720 parameter tuples, 479 strict; these tests do not establish the universal quantification.
